name: Contact Form Automation
description: Comprehensive workflow demonstrating NetPad's automation capabilities: conditional routing, MongoDB operations, email notifications, and data transformation

nodes.label: Save to Database
nodes.notes: Saves form submission to MongoDB collection

config.expression: {"fullName": trigger.payload.data.name, "emailAddress": trigger.payload.data.email, "contactMethod": trigger.payload.data.preferredContact, "inquiry": {"type": trigger.payload.data.inquiryType, "subject": trigger.payload.data.subject, "message": trigger.payload.data.message, "urgency": trigger.payload.data.urgency || "medium"}, "company": trigger.payload.data.companyName ? {"name": trigger.payload.data.companyName, "size": trigger.payload.data.companySize} : null, "metadata": {"submittedAt": trigger.payload.metadata.submittedAt, "formId": trigger.payload.metadata.formId}}

nodes.label: Normalize Data
nodes.notes: Transforms form data into structured format

nodes.label: Is Urgent?
nodes.notes: Routes urgent inquiries for immediate attention

nodes.label: Is Sales/Partnership?
nodes.notes: Routes sales inquiries to sales team

config.subject: ✅ We've received your inquiry: {{trigger.payload.data.subject}}

nodes.label: Send Confirmation
nodes.notes: Sends confirmation email to the submitter

config.subject: 🚨 URGENT: {{trigger.payload.data.subject}} from {{trigger.payload.data.name}}

nodes.label: Urgent Alert
nodes.notes: Sends immediate alert for urgent inquiries

config.subject: 💼 New {{trigger.payload.data.inquiryType}} inquiry: {{trigger.payload.data.subject}}

nodes.label: Sales Team Notification
nodes.notes: Notifies sales team of new sales/partnership inquiries

config.subject: 📬 New Contact Form Submission: {{trigger.payload.data.subject}}

nodes.label: General Notification
nodes.notes: Sends general notification for non-urgent, non-sales inquiries
